content.json:
# AI Observability usage and cost governance
Operational usage from APIM and Application Insights. Use Azure Cost Management as the financial source.

content.title: Usage summary

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ('Total Tokens', 'Prompt Tokens', 'Completion Tokens')
| extend Team=tostring(customDimensions['Team']), User=tostring(customDimensions['User']), Model=tostring(customDimensions['Model']), Project=tostring(customDimensions['Project'])
| extend Provider=iff(Model startswith 'claude', 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI')
| where '{Team}' == 'All' or Team == '{Team}'
| where '{User}' == 'All' or User == '{User}'
| where '{Model}' == 'All' or Model == '{Model}'
| where '{Provider}' == 'All' or Provider == '{Provider}'
| where '{Project}' == 'All' or Project == '{Project}'
| summarize Tokens=sum(valueSum) by bin(timestamp, 15m), Model, TokenType=name
| order by timestamp asc
content.title: Input, output, and total tokens by model

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'Total Tokens'
| extend Team=tostring(customDimensions['Team']), User=tostring(customDimensions['User']), Model=tostring(customDimensions['Model']), Project=tostring(customDimensions['Project'])
| extend Provider=iff(Model startswith 'claude', 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI')
| where '{Team}' == 'All' or Team == '{Team}'
| where '{User}' == 'All' or User == '{User}'
| where '{Model}' == 'All' or Model == '{Model}'
| where '{Provider}' == 'All' or Provider == '{Provider}'
| where '{Project}' == 'All' or Project == '{Project}'
| summarize Tokens=toint(sum(valueSum)) by Team
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: Token share by team

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'Total Tokens'
| extend Team=tostring(customDimensions['Team']), User=tostring(customDimensions['User']), Model=tostring(customDimensions['Model']), Project=tostring(customDimensions['Project'])
| extend Provider=iff(Model startswith 'claude', 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI')
| where '{Team}' == 'All' or Team == '{Team}'
| where '{User}' == 'All' or User == '{User}'
| where '{Model}' == 'All' or Model == '{Model}'
| where '{Provider}' == 'All' or Provider == '{Provider}'
| where '{Project}' == 'All' or Project == '{Project}'
| summarize Tokens=toint(sum(valueSum)) by User, Team
| order by Tokens desc
content.title: Token share by user

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where url has '/models/openai/' or url has '/models/claude/'
| extend Model=iff(url has '/models/claude/', 'claude-opus-5', 'gpt-5.4')
| extend Provider=iff(Model startswith 'claude', 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI')
| where '{Model}' == 'All' or Model == '{Model}'
| where '{Provider}' == 'All' or Provider == '{Provider}'
| summarize Requests=count(), P50Milliseconds=round(percentile(duration, 50), 0), P95Milliseconds=round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Model
| order by Model asc
content.title: Gateway latency by model

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where resultCode == '429'
| where url has '/models/openai/' or url has '/models/claude/'
| extend Model=iff(url has '/models/claude/', 'claude-opus-5', 'gpt-5.4')
| summarize QuotaResponses=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), Model, operation_Name
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Token quota responses

content.query:
customEvents
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'guardrail.decision'
| extend Guardrail=tostring(customDimensions['guardrail']), Stage=tostring(customDimensions['stage']), Outcome=tostring(customDimensions['outcome'])
| summarize Events=count() by bin(timestamp, 5m), Guardrail, Stage, Outcome
| order by timestamp desc
content.title: Guardrail outcomes

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == 'Total Tokens'
| extend Team=tostring(customDimensions['Team']), User=tostring(customDimensions['User']), Model=tostring(customDimensions['Model']), Project=tostring(customDimensions['Project'])
| summarize LastMetricUtc=max(timestamp), MetricAgeMinutes=datetime_diff('minute', now(), max(timestamp)), UnknownTeam=countif(isempty(Team) or Team == 'Unknown'), UnknownUser=countif(isempty(User) or User == 'Unknown'), UnknownModel=countif(isempty(Model) or Model == 'Unknown'), UnknownProject=countif(isempty(Project) or Project == 'Unknown')
content.title: Data freshness and unknown attribution
